verdict.rationale: RDAP evidence confirms Namecheap's own domain has DNSSEC signed with dsData present, showing the registry-level DNSSEC infrastructure works, but there is no documentation of a one-click UI toggle or an API endpoint for customers to enable/manage DNSSEC signing themselves — the SDK/API docs list only domain check/create/renew/lock methods with no DNSSEC-specific call. Missing for 10: customer-facing DNSSEC enable/disable documentation, API method for DS record management, and any hands-on confirmation of ease of setup.
